newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Trade in Denway shares suspended.
newsitem.headline: Trade in Denway shares suspended.

text.p: Trading in shares of automobile manufacturer Denway Investment Ltd was suspended at the company's request pending an announcement, the Hong Kong stock exchange said on Monday.
Shares of Denway last traded at HK$0.77 per share on Mondayy morning prior to the suspension, up HK$0.02 from Friday's close. Volume was 910,000 shares worth HK$702,800.
Denway is involved in automobile manufacturing and trading primarily through its holding in Guangzhou Peugeot, a joint venture with France's Peugeot SA.
